verdict.rationale: Bitbucket ships a built-in CI/CD tool, Pipelines, for automated workflows on hosted or private runners. The marketing docs mention deployment environments, environment-level permissions and mapping deployments to incidents in Jira Service Management, and one community comment adds that read-only deploy keys can be shared across repos. The evidence is product-page claims only, with no detail on how deployment steps are configured. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on defining and running deployment steps or environments, and independent hands-on corroboration of Pipelines deployments.
